title: One on Top of the Other
writer: Roberto Gianviti, Lucio Fulci, José Luis Martínez Mollá
actors: Jean Sorel, Marisa Mell, Elsa Martinelli
plot: An unscrupulous doctor is accused of killing his asthmatic wife as part of an insurance scam, despite discovering that she has a doppelgänger who works as a stripper and call girl.
